description: This file defines and exports multiple API endpoint objects for interacting with a backend API related to tests, execution, reports, and AI test generation. Each object contains methods for performing CRUD operations and triggering actions via HTTP requests.

methods.name: list()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of test cases from the server.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific test case by ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test case with the provided payload.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing test case identified by ID with the given payload.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a test case by ID.

methods.name: trigger(payload)
methods.description: Triggers a test execution with the given payload.

methods.name: status(runId)
methods.description: Checks the status of a test execution by run ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific report by ID.

methods.name: generate(prompt)
methods.description: Generates AI-based tests using the provided prompt.
